newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-DORTMUND V MOENCHENGLADBACH FACTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-DORTMUND V MOENCHENGLADBACH FACTS.

text.p: Facts and figures for the German first division match between Borussia Dortmund and Borussia Moenchengladbach in Dortmund on Saturday:
Major honours: European Cup Winners' Cup champions 1966; German champions 1956, 1957, 1963, 1995, 1996; German Cup winners 1965, 1989.
Major honours: UEFA Cup winners 1975, 1979; German champions 1970, 1971, 1975, 1976, 1977; German Cup winners 1960, 1973, 1995.
League record in Dortmund from 1986-87 season (Dortmund score first): 0-2 1-1 0-0 3-0 1-1 2-2 4-1 3-0 1-1 2-1
Moenchengladbach's highest ever league win was against Dortmund in April 1978 - 12-0.

Last league meeting in Dortmund: September 1, 1995. Dortmund's first victory of the 1995-96 term. Swedish striker Martin Dahlin put the visitors ahead in the 19th minute but a Stefan Reuter penalty (54th) and Lars Ricken winner (80th) clinched the victory in front of a 42,000 crowd.
